title: OFSCP POST /api/groups/{groupId}/join request body (v0.1)
description: Optional body of a group join (§5.7). The body may be absent or zero-length (not validated); a JSON body, including `{}`, is validated against this schema when the caller is not a member and the group's effective join policy is `request` (a repeat while a request is pending included), and ignored otherwise. A provider may enforce its own maximum length for `message`.

message.description: Optional note from the requester, stored as JoinRequest.message. Never null.
